summary: 2 routes confirmed (preview, commit). 9-step commit orchestration confirmed in handler_commit.go. §11.2 single source confirmed in pricing.go (ComputeShippingFee; ShippingFeeThreshold=150000 minor; boundary inclusive). Compensation matrix confirmed for 3 branches; HOWEVER: InventoryClient and PaymentClient do NOT carry X-Internal-Secret — they pass bearerToken only (code_mismatch vs ADR-008 + td.json spec requiring X-Internal-Secret for steps 6/8 + compensations). OrderClient correctly sends both bearerToken + internalSecretOption. buyerEmail wire confirmed: step 2 reads identity.profile.read; profile.Email forwarded to order.CreateFromCheckout step 7. INFLIGHT race fix confirmed: INSERT ON CONFLICT (key, customer_user_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING key in TryClaimOrLookup. Compensation retries: 3-retry [50,200,800]ms confirmed in ReleaseReservation and CancelOnCheckoutFailure client methods; handler delegates single call to each client. Test count: 18+11+5 = 34 named cases across 3 test files (14 top-level Test functions); Dev report claims 41 — gap of 7 (code_mismatch). Findings: 2 code_mismatch, 0 spec_incomplete, 0 spec_wrong.

findings.scenario: InventoryClient and PaymentClient do not send X-Internal-Secret on internal hops
findings.expected: td.json steps 4b (inventory.stock.bulk-read), 6 (inventory.reservation.create), 8 (payment.intent.create), and both compensation calls (reservation.release) MUST use X-Internal-Secret per ADR-008. NewInventoryClient and NewPaymentClient constructor signatures accept no internalSecret parameter; all three call sites use bearerAuthOption(bearerToken) only.
findings.actual: client_inventory.go: NewInventoryClient(baseURL string, ...) — no internalSecret field. BulkReadStock, CreateReservation, ReleaseReservation all pass bearerAuthOption(bearerToken) only. client_payment.go: NewPaymentClient(baseURL string, ...) — same pattern. Only OrderClient (client_order.go) correctly sends both bearerAuthOption + internalSecretOption.

findings.scenario: Test count mismatch: Dev report claims 41; actual named cases = 34
findings.actual: handler_commit_test.go: 7 top-level Test functions, 18 named table cases (10 in PreDBValidation, 4 in IdempotencyKey_DecisionMatrix, 2 in ComputeRequestHash_Determinism, 5 in IsValidIdempotencyKey via slice, 4 in TestExtractOrderIDFromEnvelope, 1 TestCompensationBackoffShape, 1 TestServiceConstruction). handler_preview_test.go: 5 top-level Test functions, 11 named table cases (7 in PreCallValidation, 4 in PricingTier_BAPR002, plus TestStockBySkU/TestFindAddress/TestPreview_EmptyCartEnvelopeShape). access/storage_idempotency_race_test.go: 2 top-level Test functions, 5 named table cases in TestTryClaimOrLookup_HandlerBranchMatrix plus TestTryClaimOrLookup_APIExists. Grand total named cases: 34; top-level Test funcs: 14. Neither matches 41.
